dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent irregular structures are visible on the posterior-lateral flank: a large, jagged 'O' shape in the upper-right quadrant with a sharp gradient transition from a dark exterior to a thin, high-contrast light perimeter; a smaller 'C' shaped ring in the mid-right section; and a lower semi-circular 'O' structure composed of fragmented, high-intensity pixel segments.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of asymmetrical, high-intensity pixel clusters located in the mid-lateral region, manifesting as isolated punctate dots and short linear streaks with uniform pixel intensity and no internal gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A scalene triangle is formed by connecting the centroids of the upper 'O' structure, the mid-lateral 'C' structure, and the lower posterior 'O' structure, with the most acute angle directed towards the posterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: A series of 4-5 parallel, vertically-oriented high-contrast linear segments are present on the extreme posterior-lateral margin, forming a comb-like pattern.
